items.name: Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE1NzA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--07597810665c0936f4ead98d017372ae67e01661/Instagram.jpg) **Russian** ​ Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2025 - это ежегодный чемпионат Казахстана. За призовые места на данном чемпионате могут бороться только участники, представляющие Казахстан. ​ Данные сореванования организованы командой QBERS. ​ **Kazakh** ​ Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2025 - жыл сайын өтетін Қазақстан чемпионаты. Осы чемпионатта жүлделі орындарды тек Қазақстан үшін жарысатын қатысушылар ғана ала алады. ​ Бұл жарыстарды QBERS командасы ұйымдастырады. ​ **English** ​ Cubing Kazakhstan Nationals 2025 is an annual national championship of Kazakhstan. Only the participants representing Kazakstan can compete for prizes at this competition. ​ These competitions are organized by the QBERS team

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODAxMDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1d45170eaf0bd2a1efc083a1a69d18c72f8b5cdf/unnamed.jpg) WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49246-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49245-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49246-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaOpen2025#49245-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

For 3x3 finals, the top 6 Irish competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the final in addition to the top 6 remaining best competitors of any region. **Free T-Shirt:** All registered competitors will receive a free t-shirt. Please fill in your t-shirt size in the comment box when registering. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionship2025#59073-t-shirts) **Fewest Moves Challenge**: FMC will not be held at this competition.
